svg.text: Artifact use — replacement design: specified vs unresolved
R = consumed W = produced/updated ? = proposed or unspecified binding — = no established use
Counts are consuming stages, not physical files. Current-script results can be values, not saved files.
Each connection’s actor, fields, purpose and transfer form are in the companion stage-by-stage page.
Zero established reads with ? is a definition gap—not proof that an artifact is unused.
